title: Cursor plugin manifest (.cursor-plugin/plugin.json) as generated by this repository
description: Maintained here. Modeled on the manifests published in github.com/microsoft/skills (.github/plugins/*/.cursor-plugin/plugin.json, checked 2026-10-14) and on https://cursor.com/docs/reference/plugins (mcpServers as a file path or inline config; Cursor expands ${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT} and not the standard's ${PLUGIN_ROOT}; checked 2026-10-22). End-to-end install in Cursor has not been verified by this repository yet.

oneOf.description: Inline server configs keyed by name, used when a server needs Cursor's own plugin-root variable. Cursor infers the transport from command or url.
